title: An integer series of integer rectifiable triples is represented by one integer rectifiable triple
statement:
Let P, n ∈ ℕ, H := μHE[n] on ℝ^P, and U ⊆ ℝ^P open. Assume tangent locality in U: for all H-null-measurable M₁, M₂ ⊆ U and all θ₁, θ₂ : ℝ^P → ℝ with θ_i > 0 on M_i and θ_i H-integrable on M_i ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U, for H-a.e. x ∈ M₁ ∩ M₂ every weighted approximate tangent space Q of (M₁, θ₁) at x is also one of (M₂, θ₂) at x. Let (M_r, θ_r, ξ_r) (r ∈ ℕ) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U n with θ_r natural-valued on M_r, and let c_r ∈ ℤ with Σ'_r |c_r|·∫⁻_{M_r ∩ W} ofReal θ_r dH < ∞ for every W ⊂⊂ U. Then there is a triple (M', θ', ξ') satisfying IsRectifiableTriple U n, with θ' natural-valued on M', such that for every ω ∈ D^n(U):
HasSum (r ↦ c_r·tauAction n M_r θ_r ξ_r ω) (tauAction n M' θ' ξ' ω).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → (∀ (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ), M₁ ⊆ U → M₂ ⊆ U → NullMeasurableSet M₁ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet M₂ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ x ∈ M₁, 0 < θ₁ x) → (∀ x ∈ M₂, 0 < θ₂ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ₁ (M₁ ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ₂ (M₂ ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₁ θ₁ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₂ θ₂ x Q) → ∀ (M : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)) (θ : ℕ → Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : ℕ → Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (c : ℕ → ℤ), (∀ r, IsRectifiableTriple U n (M r) (θ r) (ξ r)) → (∀ r, ∀ x ∈ M r, ∃ k : ℕ, θ r x = k) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * ∫⁻ x in M r ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ r x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) < ∞) → ∃ (M' : Set (Eucl P)) (θ' : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ' : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M' θ' ξ' ∧ (∀ x ∈ M', ∃ k : ℕ, θ' x = k) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun r => (c r : ℝ) * tauAction n (M r) (θ r) (ξ r) ω) (tauAction n M' θ' ξ' ω)
